definitions.gloss: to send back; to return (documents, items)
definitions.explanation: To return something to its original sender or location, often documents or submissions that require revision.

definitions.gloss: to remand (a case to a lower court)
definitions.explanation: Legal term for sending a case back to a lower court for retrial or reconsideration.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{差|さ}し{戻|もど}された。
⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{不備|ふび}→不備：07599_fubi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{差|さ}し{戻|もど}された。
examples.english: The documents were sent back because there were deficiencies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{申請書|しんせいしょ}→申請書：07486_shinseisho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{修正|しゅうせい}して→修正する：25527_shuuseisuru⟧{再提出|さいていしゅつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧よう{差|さ}し{戻|もど}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I received a request to revise and resubmit the application.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{高裁|こうさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{差|さ}し{戻|もど}した。
examples.english: The case was remanded to the High Court.

examples.japanese: {最高裁|さいこうさい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{消|け}し→取り消す：04224_torikesu⟧、⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{原審|げんしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{差|さ}し{戻|もど}した。
examples.english: The Supreme Court overturned the verdict and remanded the case to the original court.

examples.japanese: {差|さ}し{戻|もど}し{審|しん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{検討|けんとう}→検討：02710_kentou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In the retrial after remand, new evidence was also examined.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧)
- Pattern: X⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧Y⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{差|さ}し{戻|もど}す

COMPOUND VERB STRUCTURE:
⟦{差|さ}す→差す：17637_sasu⟧ (various meanings including 'to send') + ⟦{戻|もど}す→戻す：02317_modosu⟧ (to return) = to send back

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{差|さ}し{戻|もど}す - to return documents
- ⟦{申請|しんせい}→申請：04207_shinsei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{差|さ}し{戻|もど}す - to send back an application
- ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{差|さ}し{戻|もど}す - to remand a case
- {原審|げんしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{差|さ}し{戻|もど}す - to remand to the original court

FORMS:
{差|さ}し{戻|もど}し - the act of sending back; remand
- {差|さ}し{戻|もど}し{審|しん} - retrial after remand

LEGAL CONTEXT:
In Japanese law, {差|さ}し{戻|もど}し is a technical term used when a higher court sends a case back to a lower court. Different from ⟦{破棄|はき}→破棄：08642_haki⟧ (reversal) which simply overturns without requiring retrial.

REGISTER:
Slightly formal. Common in administrative, business, and legal contexts.
